title: The author panel's ceremony: its context and transcript check, the author approvals record, its check and boarding, and board-entry version 7
generator: packages/crypto/scripts/author-ceremony-vectors.py: an independent Python implementation (standard library only), reusing ceremony-vectors.py's rounds and transcript check and key-set-vectors.py's key set hash and registration statement. Every value is test data, never keys

transcripts.description: A 2-of-3 author panel, every seat honest: all three qualify.
A 1-of-1 author panel: one seat, no challenges, qualified with k_A = 1.
A 1-of-2 author panel with seat 2 absent: one qualified seat meets k_A = 1 and max(k_A, n_A - 1) = 1.
A 2-of-4 author panel with seats 3 and 4 absent: the transcript check passes with k_A = 2, but rule 7 needs 3.
Author seat 2 registers the default panel's seat-1 identity key as its signing key: duplicate-key across panels.
In the default panel's run of the same election, seat 3 registers author seat 1's identity key as its signing key.

contexts.description: author-honest-3 checked with the panel's identifier under abolish/v1/panel
author-honest-3 checked over the default panel's stub hash

records.description: Seats 2 then 1, each signature valid: the record counts for no one.
Seat 1 twice: not strictly increasing, so the record counts for no one.
Seats 1, 2 and 4 of a 3-seat panel: out of range, so the record counts for no one.
Seats 1 and 2 in order, each carrying the other's signature: neither verifies.
Seat 2 signs another key set hash: only seat 1 counts.
Seats 1 and 2 sign with the panel's identifier under abolish/v1/panel.
Seats 1 and 2 sign over the default panel's stub hash.
Seat 2's slot carries a signature by seat 3's key over seat 2's statement.
Seats 1 and 2 approve, naming another transcript hash (and signing over it).
The 1-of-1 panel's seat approves: q_A = max(1, 0) = 1.
The 1-of-2 panel's seat 1 approves: q_A = max(1, 1) = 1.
Both qualified seats of the short 2-of-4 run approve.
